recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-8203 unless Pharmacy later changes the request-resource boundary for total parenteral nutrition.
issue_request: FHIR-8203 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy issue asking MedicationPrescription to explicitly include ordering total parenteral nutrition and distinguish that from NutritionOrder/diet orders.
initial_application: Git commit 1035927e2bb56676468ca554f2325536de2c059d (#8203) added total parenteral nutrition and diet/vitamin supplements to the then-current MedicationOrder scope text. The resource later became MedicationRequest, and the current source preserves the same semantic boundary.
additional_context: FHIR-7172 is the paired OO issue excluding hyperalimentation/parenteral nutrition from NutritionOrder and pointing to Pharmacy. Current NutritionOrder boundaries direct parenteral (IV) nutrition to MedicationRequest. Later FHIR-15943 and a 2019 Zulip implementer thread both support TPN being outside NutritionOrder.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because active MedicationRequest source already satisfies the Pharmacy-side total parenteral nutrition clarification.

related_jiras.note: Paired OO issue excluding hyperalimentation/parenteral nutrition from NutritionOrder and pointing the topic to Pharmacy.
